questions.question: Which of the following best explains the phenomenon of 'October heat'?
options: Onset of winter rains in Peninsular India
Hot days and oppressive humidity despite clear skies
Sharp fall in temperatures and humidity
Sudden cyclonic storms due to retreating monsoon
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Sudden cyclonic storms due to retreating monsoon) है।

questions.question: In the context of the 73rd Amendment of the Indian Constitution, which of the following is NOT a compulsory provision for states?
options: Direct elections to all Panchayat levels
Reservation of seats for Backward Classes
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Reservation of seats for Backward Classes) है।

Why was the Battle of Wandiwash (1760) significant?
options: It led to the establishment of French supremacy in India.
It marked the end of Dutch power in India.
It ended the Anglo-French struggle in India with British victory.

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (It ended the Anglo-French struggle in India with British victory.) है।
